parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: ClusterType
parameters.description: The type of the instance. Valid values: ZooKeeper, Nacos-Ans, and Eureka.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse query-cluster-disk-specification --cluster-type ZooKeeper --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse QueryClusterDiskSpecification --region cn-hangzhou --AcceptLanguage zh --ClusterType ZooKeeper
